answer: The zephyr of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on redundant verification across independent nodes. The nectar holds work receipts rather than names, so the ripple of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a bullet-like short clauses, then a summary line register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
